license_required.quote: A license is required to engage in the practice of medicine, on or for any person in Utah, as a physician and surgeon

issuing_authority.quote: The division shall issue to a person who qualifies under this chapter a license in the classification of physician and surgeon

name.quote: Board means the Medical Licensing Board created in Section 58-67-201

type.quote: Board means the Medical Licensing Board created in Section 58-67-201

umbrella_agency.value: Division of Professional Licensing, Department of Commerce
umbrella_agency.quote: There is created within the Department of Commerce the Division of Professional Licensing

degree_required.value: Doctor of Medicine (M.D.) from LCME accredited school or equivalent foreign medical school certification
degree_required.quote: having received an earned degree of doctor of medicine from an LCME accredited medical school or college; or if the applicant graduated from a medical school or college located outside the United States or the United States' territories, submitting a current certification by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates

accrediting_body.value: LCME (Liaison Committee on Medical Education) or Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates
accrediting_body.quote: having received an earned degree of doctor of medicine from an LCME accredited medical school or college; or if the applicant graduated from a medical school or college located outside the United States or the United States' territories, submitting a current certification by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates

required.quote: satisfy the division and board that the applicant: has successfully completed 24 months of progressive resident training in a program approved by the ACGME

duration.quote: has successfully completed 24 months of progressive resident training in a program approved by the ACGME, the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons, the College of Family Physicians of Canada, or any similar body in the United States or Canada

kind.quote: has successfully completed 24 months of progressive resident training in a program approved by the ACGME

exams.name: Licensing examination sequence
exams.quote: pass the licensing examination sequence required by division rule made in collaboration with the board

interval_years.quote: the division shall issue each license under this chapter in accordance with a two-year renewal cycle established by division rule

required.quote: complete qualified continuing professional education requirements in accordance with the number of hours and standards defined by division rule made in collaboration with the board

period_years.quote: during each two-year licensure cycle or other cycle defined by division rule

available.quote: An applicant for licensure as a physician and surgeon by endorsement who is currently licensed to practice medicine in any state other than Utah, a district or territory of the United States, or Canada shall: be currently licensed with a full unrestricted license in good standing

requirements.value: Currently licensed with full unrestricted license in good standing in another state/territory/Canada; actively engaged in legal practice of medicine for not less than 6,000 hours during five years immediately preceding application; passed equivalent licensing examination sequence or examination in another jurisdiction
requirements.quote: be currently licensed with a full unrestricted license in good standing in any state, district, or territory of the United States, or Canada; have been actively engaged in the legal practice of medicine in any state, district, or territory of the United States, or Canada for not less than 6,000 hours during the five years immediately preceding the date of application for licensure in Utah; ... have passed the licensing examination sequence required in Subsection (1)(f) or another medical licensing examination sequence in another state, district or territory of the United States, or Canada that the division in collaboration with the board by rulemaking determines is equivalent

exists.quote: Board means the Medical Licensing Board created in Section 58-67-201

regulatory_model.quote: A license is required to engage in the practice of medicine, on or for any person in Utah, as a physician and surgeon

credential_type.quote: The division shall issue to a person who qualifies under this chapter a license in the classification of physician and surgeon

is_mandatory.quote: A license is required to engage in the practice of medicine, on or for any person in Utah, as a physician and surgeon, except as specifically provided in Section 58-1-307 or 58-67-305

title_protection.quote: to use, in the conduct of any occupation or profession pertaining to the diagnosis or treatment of human diseases or conditions in any printed material, stationery, letterhead, envelopes, signs, or advertisements, the designation "doctor," "doctor of medicine," "physician," "surgeon," "physician and surgeon," "Dr.," "M.D.," or any combination of these designations in any manner which might cause a reasonable person to believe the individual using the designation is a licensed physician and surgeon

scope_protection.quote: to diagnose, treat, correct, administer anesthesia, or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain or other condition, physical or mental, real or imaginary, including to perform cosmetic medical procedures, or to attempt to do so, by any means or instrumentality, and by an individual in Utah or outside the state upon or for any human within the state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a passing score on a licensure examination, applying for or obtaining a license, or otherwise dealing with the division through fraud, forgery, or intentional deception
disciplinary_grounds.quote: obtaining a passing score on a licensure examination, applying for or obtaining a license, or otherwise dealing with the division or a licensing board through the use of fraud, forgery, or intentional deception, misrepresentation, misstatement, or omission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or engaging in the practice of medicine without a license or while restricted by a suspended, revoked, or restricted license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing or engaging in, representing oneself to be practicing or engaging in, or attempting to practice or engage in any profession requiring licensure under this title, except the behavioral health technician under Chapter 60, Part 6, Behavioral Health Coach and Technician Licensing Act, if the person is: not licensed to do so or not exempted from licensure under this title; or restricted from doing so by a suspended, revoked, restricted, temporary, probationary, or inactive license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine through gross incompetence, gross negligence, or a pattern of incompetency or negligence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing or attempting to practice a or profession regulated under this title through gross incompetence, gross negligence, or a pattern of incompetency or negligence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine through false, misleading, deceptive, or fraudulent action or communication
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing or attempting to practice a profession regulated under this title by any form of action or communication which is false, misleading, deceptive, or fraudulent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine beyond the scope of the licensee's competency, abilities, education, or license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing or attempting to practice a profession regulated under this title beyond the scope of the licensee's competency, abilities, or education; practicing or attempting to practice a profession regulated under this title beyond the scope of the licensee's license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Verbally, physically, mentally, or sexually abusing or exploiting any person through conduct connected with the licensee's practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: verbally, physically, mentally, or sexually abusing or exploiting any person through conduct connected with the licensee's practice under this title or otherwise facilitated by the licensee's license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine despite being physically or mentally unfit to do so
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing or attempting to practice a profession regulated under this title despite being physically or mentally unfit to do so

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct involving intoxicants, drugs, narcotics, or similar chemicals that impairs the ability to safely practice medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in conduct, including the use of intoxicants, drugs, narcotics, or similar chemicals, to the extent that the conduct does, or might reasonably be considered to, impair the ability of the licensee or applicant to safely engage in the profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing primary or secondary sex characteristic surgical procedures on individuals under 18 years old
disciplinary_grounds.quote: performing, or causing to be performed, upon an individual who is less than 18 years old: a primary sex characteristic surgical procedure; or a secondary sex characteristic surgical procedure

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing or inducing an abortion in violation of statutory requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: performing or inducing an abortion in violation of the requirements of Section 76-7-302 or Section 76-7a-201, regardless of whether the individual licensed under this chapter is found guilty of a crime in connection with the violation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsely making an entry in or altering a medical record with intent to conceal wrongful or negligent acts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: falsely making an entry in, or altering, a medical record with the intent to conceal: a wrongful or negligent act or omission of an individual licensed under this chapter or an individual under the direction or control of an individual licensed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Designating a child as do not resuscitate without parental consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: designating a child as do not resuscitate without parental consent

definition_quote.value: Practice of medicine means: to diagnose, treat, correct, administer anesthesia, or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain or other condition, physical or mental, real or imaginary, including to perform cosmetic medical procedures, or to attempt to do so, by any means or instrumentality, and by an individual in Utah or outside the state upon or for any human within the state; when a person not licensed as a physician directs a licensee under this chapter to withhold or alter the health care services that the licensee has ordered; to maintain an office or place of business for the purpose of doing any of the acts described above whether or not for compensation; or to use certain medical designations in printed material, stationery, letterhead, envelopes, signs, or advertisements in any manner which might cause a reasonable person to believe the individual using the designation is a licensed physician and surgeon
definition_quote.quote: Practice of medicine means: to diagnose, treat, correct, administer anesthesia, or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain or other condition, physical or mental, real or imaginary, including to perform cosmetic medical procedures, or to attempt to do so, by any means or instrumentality, and by an individual in Utah or outside the state upon or for any human within the state

methods_authorized.quote: to diagnose, treat, correct, administer anesthesia, or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain or other condition, physical or mental, real or imaginary, including to perform cosmetic medical procedures

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe prescription drugs and devices as defined in statute
drug_authority.quote: Prescription drug means a drug that is required by federal or state law or rule to be dispensed only by prescription or is restricted to administration only by practitioners

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical school graduates must submit current certification by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates or successor organization approved by the division; must complete one calendar year of supervised clinical training in a U.S. medical education setting accredited by LCGME; must complete postgraduate hospital training of 24 months; must pass the division's examination
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: has attained a passing score on the educational commission for foreign medical graduates examination or other qualifying examinations such as the United States Medical Licensing Exam parts I and II, which are approved by the division or a medical school approved by the division; (e) has satisfactorily completed one calendar year of supervised clinical training under the direction of a United States medical education setting accredited by the liaison committee for graduate medical education and approved by the division; (f) has completed the postgraduate hospital training required by Subsection 58-67-302(1)(e)(i); and (g) has passed the examination required by the division of all applicants for licensure

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: has successfully completed 24 months of progressive resident training in a program approved by the ACGME, the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons, the College of Family Physicians of Canada, or any similar body in the United States or Canada approved by the division in collaboration with the board

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: if the applicant is applying to participate in the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact under Chapter 67b, Interstate Medical Licensure Compact, consent to a criminal background check in accordance with Section 58-67-302.1

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: If the division and a majority of the board find reasonable cause to believe a physician, who is not determined judicially to be an incapacitated person or to have a mental illness, is incapable of practicing medicine with reasonable skill regarding the safety of patients, because of illness, excessive use of drugs or alcohol, or as a result of any mental or physical condition, the board shall recommend that the director file a petition with the division

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: Every physician who accepts the privilege of being licensed under this chapter gives consent to: submitting at the physician's own expense to an immediate mental or physical examination when directed in writing by the division and a majority of the board to do so

investigational_drug_protection.quote: in compliance with Section 58-85-103: obtaining an investigational drug or investigational device; administering the investigational drug to an eligible patient; or treating an eligible patient with the investigational drug or investigational device
